_comment: Phase 4c stress dictionary (issue #100): dev-tool terms chosen so their likely ASR mis-renderings collide with common English words spanning the zipf-frequency spectrum — from very common (next 5.6, number 5.0, beat 4.8) down through the threshold danger zone (dusk 2.8, odd/sod, Dino ~3.5) to rare (polars, pinia). Used to probe whether the single-token zipf>=2.5 gate holds across the spectrum: high-freq collisions must be suppressed (over-fire killed), and recoveries whose original is rare must be spared.
